beats.care: Leave early for trains, ISBTs or the airport through central Delhi. Avoid non-essential trips there.
beats.what: On Monday, entry and exit were shut at Rajiv Chowk, Patel Chowk, Janpath, Mandi House, Central Secretariat and Barakhamba Road, 6 am–4 pm.
beats.why: Opposition leaders marched over the voter-list revision (SIR). Police cited the law and order situation.

cards.body: They included Dhaula Kuan flyover, Lodhi Road flyover, Mandi House and Rail Bhawan roundabouts.
cards.caption: Points flagged for diversions on Monday

cards.body: Delhi Traffic Police posted that traffic may be hit at various places across Delhi on October 13 too, with diversions based on ground conditions.
Time Out Delhi reported 57 Metro stations were shut two days before Monday's closures.

cards.q: How do you dodge protest-day traffic?

opts: Change lines and exit at another station
cards.q: If your Metro exit is shut but interchange is open, what can you do?
cards.why: Interchange stayed open, so riders could switch lines and leave from a nearby open station.

cover.label: Central Metro stations with gates shut Monday

hook: Heading to CP today? *Your route may change* without warning

learn.t: On Monday, interchange stayed open at the six shut stations, so riders could still switch lines inside.

tldr: Delhi Traffic Police warned of dynamic diversions again on Tuesday after protests shut six central Metro stations' gates on Monday.
watch: Check Delhi Traffic Police's X handle or call 1095 before heading into central Delhi on Tuesday.
